messages:
Lina: Quick heads-up — I noticed the Troubleshooting > Error Reference page has two different examples for handling 429s: one suggests exponential backoff + jitter, the other leans on immediate short-circuit to a lower-quality model. They contradict the SDK snippet that recommends header-based retry windows. Can we align before the next release?
James: Good catch. I think the variance came from different PRs landing simultaneously. I can paste the SDK snippet in a sec.
Sophie: @Lina can you point to the two sections? I'll take the one that recommends fallback model behavior.
Lina: Sure — section A under "429/Too Many Requests" (lines ~120-130) and section B under "Fallback behavior" (lines ~380-390). Also see `sdk/docs/retries.ts` example.
James: snippet: `await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-medium', input, retry: { strategy: 'exp-backoff', maxAttempts: 4, jitter: true } })`
James: The SDK team intentionally added header-aware retries (uses `x-retry-after-ms` if present). Docs should mention the header-first behavior + config override.
Sophie: Makes sense. Proposal: canonicalize the runbook to recommend header-aware retry, then fallback to short-circuit to lower-cost model only after N attempts or if latency SLO is critical.
Hari: +1. Also add a tiny flowchart or a short bullet list so folks implementing clients don't have to parse prose. I can hack a quick ascii flow and Sophie can convert to the markdown block.
Lina: That would be perfect. Also a tiny code example showing `if (retryAfter) wait(retryAfter)` then fallback.
Sophie: I'll open a docs PR today. Plan: fix wording in both sections, add a code block showing header-first behavior, and include the flow bullets. Will tag SDK and infra for review.
James: I'll review the SDK snippet and add a comment about `x-retry-after-ms` vs `retry-after` semantics.
Lina: doc-bot: create task for crosslinking the SDK example and ErrRef page?
doc-bot: Created TASK-7845 and linked to this thread :white_check_mark:
Sophie: Quick question — do we want a compatibility note for dedicated/private customers who may have gateways that strip headers?
James: Yes, add a note: "If upstream proxies strip retry headers, SDK falls back to configured exponential backoff; consider setting `maxAttempts` lower for latency-sensitive services."
Hari: I'll add that line and a tiny test matrix (proxy present / header preserved / header stripped) to the PR checklist.
Lina: Thanks all. Sophie — ping me when PR is up and I'll do a copy edit. :sparkles:
Sophie: Will do, PR in the next 3 hours.
James: thx. :thumbsup:
Lina: Closing loop — once PR merges, we'll add a redirect from the older err-ref fragment that people link to externally. I'll track with TASK-7845.
